messages:
Maria S: FYI customer POC hit a hard stop — function-call JSON coming back with extra text and failing our schema validation. They're blocked from demo tomorrow. Can we swarm? :exclamation:
Devon K: On it. Which model + call pattern are they using? sample request?
Maria S: Using hosted endpoint -> model: rw-infer-2.1-large, function_call with JSON mode on. Customer code uses strict JSON schema validation. I asked for logs but they said it returns an error parsing the tool payload.
Kyle (Sales): Can we offer credits if this drags on? They're on an enterprise eval — legal ask about SLA. Also QSA is pending, they want SOC2/pen-test timeline.
Ingrid (Eng): Need the raw example. Often this is trailing text outside the JSON envelope (e.g. "\n\nNote: ..."). Ask them for the exact response body. Also which streaming mode? chunked?
Maria S: Pasted minimal failure they sent (sanitized):
```
{"tool_result": "{\"order_id\":12345, \"status\": \"ok\"}DATA: unexpected token"}
JSON parse error at char 62: Extra data
```
Devon K: ugh. Looks like the model appended a debug footer. Could be fallback to text generation on a partial failure. Any rate limit or 502 in traces?
OpsBot: Notice: recent spike in 429s for that zone between 2026-08-12T14:02 and 14:05 UTC, backoffs applied. Request IDs: rq_58a9.., rq_58aB..
Ingrid (Eng): If we saw rate-limited retries the runtime might've retried via a compat path that doesn't enforce json_mode. Two actionable immediate workarounds: 1) Client-side: set function_call: "none" and parse with a small prompt wrapper (less strict) OR 2) Server-side quick patch: enforce strict json wrapper and drop any trailing non-json bytes before delivering tool payload. I can push a hotfix to the ingress sanitizer in 30-45m.
Kyle (Sales): I'll tell them we can fast-track a credit and a hotfix ETA. Need exact customer name + POC window to confirm. Also need SOC2 artifacts — do we have a fresh bundle?
Devon K: @Ingrid can you confirm if the sanitizer patch will change semantics for other customers? We need to avoid regressions.
Ingrid (Eng): Patch will be opt-in per-customer for now (config flag on Dedicated/Private). For hosted we'll roll it behind a feature flag tied to the tenant. It strips trailing bytes after the matching JSON object and logs the truncation event. Non-destructive.
Maria S: Perfect. I'll relay: ETA ~45m for hosted opt-in, temp workaround: set function_call to none and add a small regex to extract first JSON blob. Also request ops to surface the exact request IDs from the POC for debugging.
Devon K: Also asking SRE to check the retry policy — if retries switch to compat mode on 502/timeout we need to fix fallback path.
OpsBot: Incident note attached: rate-limit window corresponds to quota exhaustion for the customer's region. Auto-escalation triggered.
Kyle (Sales): I'll draft the customer reply: 1) Apology, 2) temporary client workaround + example, 3) we're enabling opt-in sanitizer and ETA 45m, 4) credits + SOC2 link. Anyone want to review the message before I send?
Ingrid (Eng): I'll review, add a short technical appendix. Also will attach the minimal patch diff once CI passes.
Maria S: Thanks all — assigning follow-ups: Ingrid = sanitizer opt-in rollout; Devon = request IDs & SRE retry trace; Kyle = customer comms/credits; I'll coordinate QSA docs. Back in ~1hr with updates. :thumbsup:
